findings.description: The configuration comment states this bucket is public, and no public access block, restrictive ACL, or bucket policy is configured to prevent it. It stores customer-master.xlsx (customer data), exposing that sensitive data to unauthenticated access on the internet.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined, so the customer data stored in this bucket is written to storage in plaintext rather than encrypted by default.
The financials bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving financial records stored in plaintext at rest in violation of the encryption-by-default requirement.
The operations bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so data it stores is unencrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so data it stores is unencrypted at rest.
